outputs.title: 商品主圖
outputs.prompt: 大きな商品写真で、第一印象を伝える。

outputs.title: 毎日に、小さなお気に入りを
outputs.prompt:
Create one photograph for a planned ecommerce image set.
Campaign hero photograph: create a refined editorial set with one large geometric plinth, directional light, dimensional shadows and breathing room. The product is the focal point; this should look like a campaign photograph rather than a catalogue copy.
Shared art direction: soft natural neutrals with restrained sage accents.
Preserve the exact source product shape, color, logo, packaging, number of pieces, and label text. Product identity stays consistent; the framing, scale, lighting and surrounding environment should serve this shot's purpose. Do not invent a back view or details that the reference does not establish.
Product identity: PLAIN 日常休閒鞋. Merchant-supplied facts: 示範休閒鞋。米白與鼠尾草綠配色。材質、尺寸與產地待商家補充。. Do not turn those facts into visible text.
Visual goal (scene and framing only): 大きな商品写真で、第一印象を伝える。.
Photography only. No new typography, captions, charts, panels, marketing claims, ingredient props, certificates or watermarks. Existing package text must remain as shown. All copy will be placed separately after the photograph is generated.

outputs.title: いつもの暮らしに
outputs.prompt:
Create one photograph for a planned ecommerce image set.
Lifestyle scene: an everyday outdoor architectural setting, low stone step and soft directional daylight; no person or invented extra accessories. Place the full product naturally within a wide enough environment to show its use context. The scene must visibly differ from a plain packshot.
Shared art direction: soft natural neutrals with restrained sage accents.
Preserve the exact source product shape, color, logo, packaging, number of pieces, and label text. Product identity stays consistent; the framing, scale, lighting and surrounding environment should serve this shot's purpose. Do not invent a back view or details that the reference does not establish.
Product identity: PLAIN 日常休閒鞋. Merchant-supplied facts: 示範休閒鞋。米白與鼠尾草綠配色。材質、尺寸與產地待商家補充。. Do not turn those facts into visible text.
Visual goal (scene and framing only): 日常の使用場面が伝わる構図にする。.
Photography only. No new typography, captions, charts, panels, marketing claims, ingredient props, certificates or watermarks. Existing package text must remain as shown. All copy will be placed separately after the photograph is generated.
